## Fixing Boston's busiest equity corridors

*2nd place, MIT Policy Hackathon 2025*

[![](/images/mbta/social-card.png){fig-alt="Fixing Boston's Busiest Equity Corridors"}](/projects/mbta-equity-corridors.html)

Every MBTA bus route, ranked by transit dependence weighted by ridership. The
three highest-need corridors turned out to be among the slowest in the network.
We modelled a $6.5M bus-priority package returning 1.23 million rider-hours a
year, paying back in under two years — then rebuilt the whole analysis as a
tested Python package after the original notebooks were lost.

[Read the full project →](/projects/mbta-equity-corridors.html)
